title: Health On My Mind
description: A quick way to set up the below_name health scoreboard
body:
A hustle-free way to set up the health scoreboard!

The datapack adds a ```/trigger heartSetup``` command (creative only for security purposes) which allows you to quickly set up a heart scoreboard below name and choose between heart colors

![Command output with options to set the heart scoreboard display as below_nem and choose between colors](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cff66b23f3c419f264453c6c885890b4cc3e5eb4.png)

![screenshot of a minecraft player with a health scoreboard below their name](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f589bde76fca6651921125ef90af09fb7a7f195b_0.webp)
